description: Search live job postings from 30+ sources in one schema. Use it to find who is hiring for a role, skill or place, not for coverage or cost questions. Returns real matching postings (title, company, location, salary, tech stack, apply URL), capped at 3 rows per call on this no-key server, with whether more match and the REST call for the full set. Filters marked "Key only." are ignored here and named in filters_dropped. Reference: https://docs.jobspipe.dev/api-reference/filters

description_or.description: Key only. Terms in the posting text.

employment_type_or.description: full-time, part-time, contract, temporary or internship.

esco_skill_id_or.description: Key only. ESCO skill concept IDs.

has_recruiter_email.description: Key only. Has a recruiter email.

include_unlabeled_employment_type.description: Key only. Keep jobs with no employment type.

job_location_or.description: City, region or country names or codes, e.g. Seattle, WA. Terms up to 3 characters match whole values.

job_title_or.description: Job titles, any of. The first 8 are used.

language_not.description: Key only. Posting languages to exclude.

max_applicant_count.description: Key only. Highest applicant count to keep.

metro_code_or.description: Key only. US CBSA metro codes.

min_salary_usd.description: Key only. Lowest posted annual salary, USD.

region_or.description: US state and Canadian province ISO 3166-2 codes, e.g. US-NY.

visa_sponsorship_or.description: Key only. Visa stance stated in the posting.

work_arrangement_or.description: Unknown arrangements never match; coverage is partial, so prefer remote.

name: search_jobs
